summary: Iteration 48: verified three admin-facing fixes — (1) /api/admin/stats members.by_tier now groups by users.tier_id and joins db.tiers, returning ONLY real tier names; (2) new admin-only endpoints /api/reports/award-grants + /api/reports/of-the-year are enriched and filterable; (3) Directory grid Member Card photo uses object-contain. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in test_iteration48_tier_chart_awards_reports.py. by_tier returned {'Honorary Member','Regular Member','Silver Life Member'} (none of 'Standard'/'Lifetime'), sorted desc by count. /reports/award-grants returns 5 enriched grants with current_user_name/user_email/user_avatar_url/chapter_name, sorted granted_at DESC, ?year=2026 narrows to 2026 rows only, ?user_id= filters correctly. /reports/of-the-year returns enriched winners with category_label ('Chapter of the Year', 'Member of the Year') sorted (year DESC, category ASC). Both endpoints return 401 for member@clubhaven.app and anonymous. Frontend (Playwright as admin@clubhaven.app): Admin → Dashboard By-Membership-Tier donut legend shows the three real tier labels above (matches a subset of the 8 tiers in db.tiers — the 3 that have members assigned). Admin → Reports → Awards sub-tab renders awards-grants-count='5 grants', oty-count='2 winners'. Riley Chen has 3 Life Membership Ribbon rows with ordinal pills '3×' and '2×' visible. Search 'Riley' filters to '3 grants' (client-side, includes name+email+award+chapter+reason). Year dropdowns awards-grants-year + oty-year render. CSV downloads succeed with exact headers per spec: 'Granted at,Member,Email,Chapter,Award,Award #,Granted by,Reason' and 'Year,Category,Winner,Email,Chapter,Note,Added by'. Directory grid card uses className 'w-full h-full object-contain' inside the 'aspect-[4/3] w-full bg-muted/40 ...' container — verified via static code review of Directory.jsx:179-186. All testids referenced in the spec (reports-tab-awards, awards-grants-count, oty-count, awards-grants-year, oty-year, awards-grants-search, awards-grants-export, oty-export, tier-chart-empty) are present in the DOM/code. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2061-2084 by_tier: the new aggregation correctly drops users with tier_id in [None,''] and silently drops dangling tier_id references (tier deleted but user still points to it). Consider logging dangling refs once per stats request so admins know to reassign — non-blocking, FYI only.

routes/reports.py:826-834 _OTY_LABELS is a local copy that mirrors routes/of_the_year.CATEGORY_LABELS. If a new category is ever added in one place but not the other, the audit report will show the raw category key instead of the human label. Low risk but a future drift hazard — consider moving the labels to a shared constants module.

routes/reports.py:798 uids = [r['user_id'] for r in rows if r.get('user_id')] then chapters fetch uses {users.get(uid) or {}).get('chapter_id') for uid in uids} — works, but if the same chapter_id appears N times it still gets deduped via set comprehension. Good.

Directory.jsx grid img only sets object-contain; the list-mode avatar at the same page still uses w-16 h-16 object-contain shrink-0 (so list mode is also OK). The single object-cover img I detected in the page DOM appears to be an unrelated image elsewhere (header/nav) — confirm not a member-card regression by reviewing the css usage tree if needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 UI checks across dashboard tier chart, awards sub-tab counts+ordinal pills+search+CSV exports, directory card class)
